name: Answer customer emails with an AI agent using live order data and escalate to a human
description: Answers customer emails in the author's voice using live order data. Complaints, uncertain answers and dedication requests go to the author with a drafted reply instead.
shortDescription: Reply to customer emails in your voice, and send complaints and uncertain answers to you for review.
keyFeatures: Gmail trigger on new customer emails
AI support agent with an order lookup tool for live order status
Escalates complaints, uncertain answers and special requests to a human with a draft reply
Sends the reviewed reply only after approval
prerequisites: Web shop with a REST API for orders; replace REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN
idealFor: Small shops that want routine customer emails answered automatically and the rest reviewed by the owner.
steps: Trigger: a new customer email in Gmail.
The support agent looks up the order and drafts a reply.
If the email needs escalation, ask the author to review and edit the reply.
Send the reviewed reply, or reply automatically when no escalation is needed.
